findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current V96 renders and Astra review: piping at both front-lap hem ends still kinks outward into short protruding tips; the hem-only edge filter has not materially improved those terminations.

Neutral, side, rear and three-quarter views retain dense horizontal ridging along the overskirt sides. Crouch and sit retain angular panel overlaps and bunching around and behind the raised thighs; the skirt silhouette is still visibly stiff and broken rather than a continuous drape.
The garment remains a prototype. Avatar fit, Shape Key response, complete UVs, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release package readiness are unverified; no release gate is satisfied by this visual review.

nextAction: Keep the hem-only selection experiment bounded and fix how piping endpoints terminate at both front-lap corners. Then change the actual overskirt side panel deformation/overlap at the hip and verify the same sit/crouch renders before considering another visual review. Do not infer fit, collision, or release from these previews. UV evidence remains partial-unverified: authored panel UV exists for the sewn garment, while sleeve, body shell, and hardware UVs are not verified.
